defense_dimensions.description: 属于单测桩代码、本地离线排障脚本或内部辅助工具，无生产环境线上影响
属于第三方开源组件或外部库底层封装，内部线程创建行为无法侵入改动
已封装自研统一 RAII 资源管理类自动执行 join/detach，无崩溃泄露风险

description: 分析 C/C++ 代码中显式创建线程的合理性与生命周期管理方式
name: thread_create

categories.label: 无问题
categories.definition: The reviewed thread-creation usage is safe and requires no change.

categories.label: 必要性-频繁创建
categories.definition: Threads are created repeatedly for short work instead of reusing execution capacity.
positive_hints: short-lived ad hoc task is acceptable
negative_hints: pool or timer has been evaluated

categories.label: 必要性-未使用平台调度组
categories.definition: The platform dispatch or scheduling group is available but thread creation is used instead.
decision_rules: created thread does not need isolation
same concurrency can be expressed natively
positive_hints: native mechanism cannot express the need

categories.label: 必要性-未使用平台定时器
categories.definition: A platform timer or delayed task mechanism should replace a sleeping thread.
positive_hints: sleep models a dedicated service loop

categories.label: 生命周期-join遗漏
categories.definition: A joinable thread is not waited for or detached before its handle and resources become ambiguous.
decision_rules: lifetime or resource cleanup is unclear

categories.label: 生命周期-未安全退出
categories.definition: Thread or owner exit does not establish a safe stop and cleanup protocol.
decision_rules: thread can be terminated while holding state
shutdown flag or notification is missing
positive_hints: stop signal and join are coordinated
negative_hints: process exit owns all cleanup safely

categories.label: 异常安全-析构崩溃
categories.definition: Owner destruction races with worker access or releases resources a thread still uses.
decision_rules: destructor can run while thread executes
negative_hints: worker is fully detached and independent

categories.label: 数据安全-悬空引用
categories.definition: Thread callback captures a stack, object, or resource reference that can outlive validity.
decision_rules: callback captures local or member state
owner can leave scope or be destroyed
positive_hints: capture is owned or lifetime is guarded

categories.label: 同步安全-数据竞争
categories.definition: Worker code reads or writes shared state without synchronized access.
decision_rules: lock or atomic ordering is missing

categories.label: 其它
categories.definition: A credible thread-creation risk that does not fit a more specific controlled category.
